pages.text: Sorry about the writing. My hands were cold.

Somewhere warmer, where the grass goes yellow and the trees are flat on top, there's a tribe in bird masks. Their king sits on a throne in the middle of a grove. He won't stay sitting for long once you walk in.
$(o)Anyone who has crossed the savanna has heard of Umvuthi, the Sunbird, and the Rogue Eye he keeps on his throne.$()
